semantic_contract: Refreshes the editor's 'BG Page Count' page-number label. Construct a 20-byte localized-string wrapper on the stack. Look up the UTFWin window whose control id is 0x47ED688 in the receiver's PlayModeUI layout (the lookup is a member call on the receiver's +0x34 pointer, adjusted to its +0x14 sub-object). If that window does not exist, do nothing beyond destroying the temporary and return. If it does exist: (1) point the temporary at localization id 0x7518573e with alternate id 0x47ED777 and the debug label L"*BG Page Count*"; (2) store receiver->[+0x38] + 1 into field +0x20 of the global substitution table at 0x015F7CF4; (3) store receiver->[+0x3C] + 1 into field +0x24 of that same table; (4) resolve the formatted text from the temporary and hand it to the window through vtable slot +0x80. Finally destroy the temporary. Invariants: both increments are unconditional and are the only arithmetic; the two global stores are plain 32-bit overwrites, not read-modify-writes; the global pointer is dereferenced without a null test; the format arguments are written before the text is formatted, never after; the temporary is constructed and destroyed on both the null and non-null paths exactly once each; the function never reads or writes any other receiver field.
subsystem_context: PKG-10-EDITOR-DISPATCH, cluster editor-core, subsystem Editor, triage GAMEPLAY_LOGIC. The function is the label-refresh step that both page-navigation edges of Editors::PlayModeBackgrounds's control-id dispatcher route through, and it is the second of the two page-count label updaters (the other being 0x0062e600 for the anim page count).
classification_rationale: The body, ABI, every field offset, every immediate, the single guard and its polarity, the global touched and the exact virtual slot are all read directly from the disassembly and are corroborated by two call sites and by the structural analogue 0x0062e600. STRONG_SEMANTIC is withheld for two named bounds. First, the owning type and method name: the SDK field layout at +0x34/+0x38/+0x3C matches and the sibling at 0x0062f710 carries an SDK symbol for the same class, but the SDK's own declared address for UpdatePageNumbers matches neither this entry nor any entry of this function, and a dword scan of .text/.rdata/.data proves the address is in no vtable, so no name is asserted. Second, the concrete implementation behind vtable slot +0x80 and the type of the global table at 0x015F7CF4 are not located; the UTFWin::IWindow::SetCaption reading is a candidate corroborated by argument type and by the neighbouring +0x7c and +0x1c slots, not an observed identity.
semantic_findings: 0x0062f550 is a live receiver load, not dead code: 0x00634dc4 is `ADD ECX,0x14`, which makes 0x00634dc0 a __thiscall and gives the callee's `this` a concrete meaning (the PlayModeUI sub-object at +0x14).

The callee 0x006b54b0 pops three stack dwords but reads only two of them; the third pushed value is the wide literal L"*BG Page Count*" and is a debug tag, proven by the structurally identical call in 0x0062e600 which passes L"Anim Page Count (PLACEHOLDER)" in the same slot.
The two stored values are each the receiver field plus one, so the field at +0x3C is an extra-page count rather than a total, matching the SDK comment on mExtraPageCount.
The global pointer at 0x015F7CF4 is dereferenced with no null guard, so a non-null window lookup is treated as proof that the global is initialised.

The argument stores at 0x0062f585/0x0062f591 strictly precede the resolve call at 0x0062f59a, so the substitution table is filled first and formatted second; the Ghidra pseudocode prints these two steps in the opposite order and must not be trusted for ordering.
The address appears in no vtable and in no other .text/.rdata/.data dword, so this is an ordinary non-virtual member reached only by direct CALL.
0x0062e600 is the same operation for the anim page-count label and shares the same localization id 0x7518573e, which is therefore a generic page-count format string rather than a per-label one.
unresolved_questions: What is the concrete class of the receiver? The SDK field layout at +0x34/+0x38/+0x3C matches Editors::PlayModeBackgrounds and the region matches, but the SDK's declared address for that class's UpdatePageNumbers matches neither 0x62F520 nor 0x62F570 to this entry, so the class assignment stays a candidate.
What is the method name? No vtable entry, no imported symbol and no SDK address exist for 0x0062f540, so UpdatePageNumbers is unconfirmed.

What does vtable slot +0x80 concretely do? The argument is a resolved text pointer and the SDK declares SetCaption at exactly +0x80, but the implementing class was not located, so the call target is unidentified.

What is the type and owner of the object at 0x015F7CF4? Fifty-one references show sibling writers at +0x18, +0x1c, +0x20, +0x24, +0x28, +0x2c and +0x34, which is consistent with a shared localized-string substitution table, but no type declaration was found.

What text does localization id 0x7518573e resolve to at run time? It is a runtime id with no static image backing and the same id drives both the anim and the background page-count labels, so its exact format string is unknown.
What does 0x00634dc0 do when its slot +0xf0 fallback runs? The creation path is observed as a call with (id, 1) but its result and side effects were not analysed.

Is 0x0062f540 ever reached with the global at 0x015F7CF4 still null while a window is found? Statically impossible to exclude; a differential trace would be needed to confirm the invariant is upheld by the callers rather than by luck.
